layoutComponents.label: Shell
layoutComponents.description: Application layout composition root and routed content host.

evolutions.name: transloco
evolutions.label: Transloco i18n
evolutions.description: Runtime i18n baseline with configurable translation assets.

options.name: translocoLanguages
options.description: Comma-separated languages to configure and generate.

options.name: translocoDefaultLanguage
options.description: Default and fallback language; it must be selected in --transloco-languages.

options.name: layoutMode
options.description: Layout component generation mode.

choices.label: Install complete layout
choices.description: Configure Shell, Header, Sidebar and Footer.

choices.label: Select layout components
choices.description: Choose Shell and only the layout regions the application needs.

choices.label: Content only
choices.description: Remove the pristine layout and render RouterOutlet directly.

options.name: layoutComponents
options.description: Comma-separated layout components to generate when --layout-mode select is used.

options.name: layoutHeaderBehavior
options.description: Header positioning behavior when Header is selected.

choices.label: Flow
choices.description: Keep Header in the normal document flow.

choices.label: Sticky
choices.description: Keep Header visible at the logical block start while scrolling.

options.name: layoutSidebarMode
options.description: Sidebar interaction mode when Sidebar is selected.

choices.label: Persistent
choices.description: Keep Sidebar expanded without a collapse control.

choices.label: Collapsible
choices.description: Add an accessible Signal-based collapse control.

options.name: layoutSidebarPosition
options.description: Logical Sidebar position when Sidebar is selected.

choices.label: Start
choices.description: Place Sidebar at the logical inline start.

choices.label: End
choices.description: Place Sidebar at the logical inline end.

options.name: layoutSidebarInitialState
options.description: Initial Sidebar state when collapsible mode is used.

choices.label: Expanded
choices.description: Render navigation expanded initially.

choices.label: Collapsed
choices.description: Render navigation collapsed initially.

options.name: layoutFooterBehavior
options.description: Footer positioning behavior when Footer is selected.

choices.label: Flow
choices.description: Keep Footer in the normal document flow.

choices.label: Sticky
choices.description: Keep Footer visible at the logical block end while scrolling.

options.name: layoutContentWidth
options.description: Main content width behavior when Shell is selected.

choices.label: Fluid
choices.description: Allow routed content to use all available width.

choices.label: Contained
choices.description: Center routed content within the configured maximum width.

evolutions.name: signal-store
evolutions.label: SignalStore
evolutions.description: Feature-scoped or root NgRx SignalStore baseline.

options.name: storeScope
options.description: SignalStore scope.

choices.label: Feature
choices.description: Generate state under src/app/features/<feature>/state.

choices.label: Root
choices.description: Generate a root-provided store under src/app/core/state.

options.name: featureName
options.description: Feature name used by feature-scoped SignalStore installers.

options.name: featureComponent
options.description: Whether the feature component already exists or should be generated.

choices.label: Already exists
choices.description: Create state/store only.

choices.label: Create it
choices.description: Create a minimal route and standalone component.

options.name: storeName
options.description: Root SignalStore name. Used only with --store-scope root.

options.name: bootstrapMode
options.description: Bootstrap component generation mode.

choices.label: Install all starter UI components
choices.description: Generate every Bootstrap wrapper component.

choices.label: Select UI components
choices.description: Choose only the Bootstrap wrappers you need.

options.name: bootstrapComponents
options.description: Comma-separated Bootstrap components to generate when --bootstrap-mode select is used.

options.name: tailwindMode
options.description: Tailwind component generation mode.

choices.label: Install all starter UI components
choices.description: Generate every Tailwind wrapper component.

choices.label: Select UI components
choices.description: Choose only the Tailwind wrappers you need.

options.name: tailwindComponents
options.description: Comma-separated Tailwind components to generate when --tailwind-mode select is used.
